Running registry for the personal research lab. Append-only in spirit; prune quarterly.

**Conventions**

- Every entry gets a pillar tag: `[R]` runtime/harness, `[E]` environments/verification, `[T]` training/optimization, `[M]` meta/RSI.
- Every entry gets a status: `queued` / `read` / `used` / `contributed`.
- If an entry drives a notebook post, link the post slug next to it. An entry that never earns a link after two quarters gets pruned.
- Dates are the date *I* added it, not the publication date.

---

## 2. Repos & tools

### Runtime / harness `[R]`

- **Annulus** (own) — local-first agentic platform; MVP is SWE, roadmap is MCP + GraphRAG + science/engineering platform.
- [karpathy/autoresearch](https://github.com/karpathy/autoresearch) — minimal autonomous research loop. Study-and-fork target; closest public analogue to Annulus's second act.
- [NousResearch/hermes-agent](https://github.com/nousresearch) — reference architecture: skills-as-procedural-memory, MCP, subagent delegation, programmatic tool calling, trajectory export.
- [NousResearch/hermes-agent-self-evolution](https://github.com/nousresearch) — DSPy + GEPA evolutionary optimization of skills/prompts/code. Directly relevant to `[M]`.
- [0xNyk/awesome-hermes-agent](https://github.com/0xNyk/awesome-hermes-agent) — community directory; useful map of the plugin/skill ecosystem.
- Claude Code — terminal, repo-scale analysis and architecture. Skills are cross-agent portable (agentskills.io standard).
- Cursor (Composer 2.5) — inline diffs + ADR review. Current daily driver.

### Environments / verification `[E]`

- [PrimeIntellect-ai/verifiers](https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/verifiers) — v1 (July 10, 2026) decomposes into tasksets / harnesses / runtimes. Dialect adapters for OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses, Anthropic Messages.
- [Environments Hub](https://hub.primeintellect.ai) — 2,500+ environments, doubles as a Python package registry (wheels + `pyproject.toml`).
- [PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-cli](https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-cli) — install/upload/manage environments.
- [PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-environments](https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-environments) — where RFCs and bounties land.
- Harbor (fully supported third-party format in verifiers v1); NeMo Gym and OpenEnv in alpha.

### Training / optimization `[T]`

- [PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-rl](https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-rl) — FSDP, SFT + RL + evals, Slurm/K8s multi-node, VLM support.
- [Hugging Face TRL](https://github.com/huggingface/trl) — local GRPO baseline; the "no managed infra" leg of the three-stack comparison.
- [Tinker](https://thinkingmachines.ai/tinker/) + [tinker-cookbook](https://github.com/thinking-machines-lab/tinker-cookbook) — GA since Dec 12, 2025. Primitives: `forward_backward`, `optim_step`, `save_state`, `sample`. LoRA-based. Checkpoint download supported.
- [NousResearch/atropos](https://github.com/nousresearch) — RL environments framework for LLM trajectories.
- **tinker-atropos** (Nous) — standalone Atropos ↔ Tinker integration; RL on real agent trajectories. The literal seam between the runtime and training pillars.

### Meta / RSI `[M]`

- OpenEvolve and similar open AlphaEvolve reproductions — evolutionary program search over a verifier.
- DSPy / GEPA — prompt and program optimization.

## 5. Benchmarks & evals

- SWE-bench Verified, Terminal-Bench 2 — Annulus eval targets.
- BrowseComp, DeepSearchQA — agentic search reference numbers.
- GPQA Diamond, HLE-with-tools, IMOAnswerBench, USAMO — science/math agent reference numbers.
- Tesseract: own Elo ladder vs. random / greedy / MCTS-only / human baselines. **Define this before writing any training code.**

*Note: vendor-reported benchmark numbers are self-reported until an independent evaluator publishes. Record the source of every number cited in a notebook post.*

## 6. Open questions

Living list. Each one is a candidate notebook post or thesis discussion section.

1. Does an LLM fine-tuned with RLVR on Tesseract approach the self-play agent's play strength, or plateau? Where exactly?
2. Can the AlphaZero-lineage agent serve as opponent *and* evaluator in an LLM RL loop for the same game?
3. What does the forgetting literature say about weight-updating self-improvement loops? Is forgetting the actual binding constraint on RSI, and does that argue for skills/memory-based improvement over weight updates?
4. What do Tinker's primitives buy over TRL's trainers that is not just convenience — and where does the abstraction leak?
5. Which of Hermes's architectural choices (memory model, skills spec, security boundary) should Annulus adopt, and which are wrong for a local-first NASA context?
6. Where does evolutionary program search stop working — what problem structure does AlphaEvolve-style search require?
